card.name: Political history of authoritarian regimes
card.fires_on: Ordinary words (verbs, 'of', 'named', 'since', name parts) in general-web text about authoritarian rulers and regimes, such as China, the Khmer Rouge, Mao and Nepal. It sits just before or inside a ruler's name or a regime-related phrase.

modes.label: Linking words near regime leaders
modes.description: Small words like 'of', 'to', 'since', 'named' right before a leader, party or power-related phrase.

modes.label: Inside leader names
modes.description: Partway through or just after a Chinese leader's name.
modes.example: last July Chinese President Hu J<<int>>ao promised an additional $20 billion

modes.label: Charging verb in tribunal news
modes.description: The verb 'charged' after a tribunal for regime crimes.
